values.message:
[CI][Misc] Upgrade vllm to v0.28.0 (#14898)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

main2main vllm upgrade to v0.28.0

---

Update CI tracking tag: `.github/vllm-release-tag.commit` from `v0.27.1`
to `v0.28.0`, and adapt the codebase so vllm-ascend works on both vLLM
v0.28.0 and vLLM main.

#### 1. Version / CI / Docker / Documentation

| File | Change Reason |
|------|---------------|
| `.github/vllm-release-tag.commit` | Update CI tracking tag: `v0.27.1`
→ `v0.28.0` |
| `Dockerfile`, `Dockerfile.310p`, `Dockerfile.310p.openEuler`,
`Dockerfile.a3`, `Dockerfile.a3.openEuler`, `Dockerfile.a5`,
`Dockerfile.a5.openEuler`, `Dockerfile.openEuler` | `ARG
VLLM_TAG=v0.27.1` → `v0.28.0` |
| `README.md`, `README.zh.md` | Update main branch description: CI
commitment for vLLM `v0.27.1` → `v0.28.0` tag |

#### 2. Drop v0.27.1 version gates (v0.28.0 upstream matches main)

All `vllm_version_is("0.27.1")` branches whose behavior v0.28.0 no
longer needs were removed, keeping only the current (main) code paths:

| File | Change Reason |
|------|---------------|
| `vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_runner.py` | Unconditional
`BatchReqState` import; `execute_model` always passes `context_len`;
single `prepare_inputs` with the main signature |
| `vllm_ascend/worker/v2/input_batch.py` | Single dataclass layout with
the `max_query_len` default field |
| `vllm_ascend/worker/v2/aclgraph_utils.py` | Keep the main `__init__`
signature only |
| `vllm_ascend/worker/model_runner_v1.py` | Drop routed-experts
`clear_buffer()` and `calculate_kv_scales` gates (removed on main only,
vllm #50721/#49389) |
| `vllm_ascend/_310p/fused_moe/grouped_topk_router.py` | Always handle
fp32-recomputed router_logits (FRACTAL_NZ on 310P) |
| `vllm_ascend/models/deepseek_mtp.py` | Always load with
`AutoWeightsLoader(skip_prefixes=["rot."])` |
| `vllm_ascend/models/qwen3_dspark.py` | Drop the local
`DSparkConfidenceHead`; upstream provides it (vllm #47808) |
| `vllm_ascend/ops/fused_moe/fused_moe.py` | Keep only the main
`weight_fp32` gate branch (vllm #51838) |
| `vllm_ascend/ops/triton/mamba/postprocess.py` | Keep only the main
`postprocess_mamba_fused_kernel` |
| `vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_kv_cache_coordinator.py` | Keep only
the main `HybridKVCacheCoordinator` signature |
| `vllm_ascend/patch/worker/patch_qwen3_5.py` | Keep only the main
qwen3_next `_all_gather_hidden_and_residual` usage |
| `vllm_ascend/compilation/acl_graph.py` | Keep only the main
`get_current_vllm_config()` handling |
| `tests/ut/patch/platform/test_patch_structured_output.py` | Normalize
to v0.28.0: `compile_grammar` takes `stop_token_ids`, `_create_grammar`
reads `all_stop_token_ids`, validation raises `VLLMValidationError` |
| `tests/ut/worker/test_model_runner_v2.py` | Drop the `is_vllm_0_27_1`
parametrization; `context_len` is always passed |
| `tests/ut/patch/worker/test_patch_mamba_utils_source.py` | Expect the
single (main) postprocess kernel |
| `tests/ut/kv_offload/test_native_cpu_offload.py`,
`tests/ut/ops/test_routed_experts.py`,
`tests/ut/patch/platform/test_deepseek_v4_thinking.py`,
`tests/ut/spec_decode/test_extract_hidden_states_proposer.py`,
`tests/e2e/pull_request/two_card/rlhf/consistency/test_moe_routing_replay.py`
| Drop 0.27.1 branches, keep main behavior |

#### 3. Bump version gates to v0.28.0 (v0.28.0 still needs the gated
behavior)

| File | Change Reason |
|------|---------------|
| `vllm_ascend/attention/attention_v1.py` |
`_gather_prefill_cache_inputs` lives in
`vllm.model_executor.layers.attention.pcp` at v0.28.0, moved to
`vllm.v1.attention.ops.pcp` on main |
| `vllm_ascend/worker/v2/spec_decode/dflash/speculator.py` | Gate the
dflash kernel variant with temperature/seeds parameters (vllm #50000) |
| `vllm_ascend/spec_decode/llm_base_proposer.py` | v0.28.0 MTP
architecture set (`DeepSeekMTPModel`/`KimiK3MTPModel`) |
| `tests/ut/core/test_recompute_scheduler.py`,
`tests/ut/core/test_profiling_chunk.py`, `tests/e2e/conftest.py` |
Update version gates from 0.27.1 to 0.28.0 |

#### 4. Remove patch_vision FusedInputNorm patch

| File | Change Reason |
|------|---------------|
| `vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_vision.py` (deleted),
`vllm_ascend/patch/platform/__init__.py`,
`vllm_ascend/patch/__init__.py` | Upstream vllm #51734 (included in
v0.28.0) rewrote `FusedInputNorm.forward` to a broadcast multiply-add,
removing `F.batch_norm`; the eps=0.0 → eps=1e-5 workaround is no longer
needed |

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

No

### How was this patch tested?

CI verification only
